note: At the head of the page of field names, in the old German script: "Aus ...", from .... Read Smięcia without doubt. On the last sheet you read "Swięcer" for what was read "Smięcer". Swięcia is a place in the edition, an estate with a farm called Broniki, and the first field name below is "Bronikel".
The note at the right of the same line: "Budendorf comes from ...".
"In ... 6 pieces each: about 1868." On the last sheet you read St[?]pin for the same-looking word four lines above ("54 years ago from ...").
